subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Stakeholder responses to a wetland restoration proposal
stimulus.description: A fictional local authority proposes to restore 600 ha of drained wetland by reducing grazing and seasonal vehicle access.
rows: Supports full restoration to increase habitat and ecosystem services.
Support partial restoration but oppose large reductions in grazing land.
Supports restoration if boardwalks and visitor access are maintained.
stimulus.note: The positions are hypothetical.

question: Explain how differences in environmental values could account for the contrasting stakeholder positions shown.
markscheme: Explains that the conservation group may hold a more ecocentric perspective, giving high value to habitat, biodiversity or ecosystem integrity.
Explains that livestock farmers may use a more anthropocentric or livelihood-focused perspective because grazing land contributes directly to income and human welfare.
Explains that the tourism association combines environmental and economic values, supporting restoration while also valuing continued human access and tourism benefits.
markschemeJa: 保全団体は生息地・生物多様性・生態系そのものの価値を重視する、よりecocentricな立場と説明する。
畜産農家は放牧地が所得や生活に直結するため、よりanthropocentricまたは生計重視の立場と説明する。
観光団体は復元を支持しつつ利用継続も求めており、環境価値と経済価値を組み合わせていると説明する。
modelAnswer: The conservation group is likely to place greater intrinsic value on ecosystems and biodiversity, so it supports full restoration. Farmers depend on grazing for income and may judge the proposal mainly through human welfare and livelihood effects. The tourism association values both a healthy wetland and continued visitor access, so its position combines environmental and economic priorities.
modelAnswerJa: 保全団体は生態系や生物多様性の内在的価値を強く重視するため全面復元を支持すると考えられます。農家は放牧による所得・生活への影響を重視します。観光団体は健全な湿地と観光利用の両方を重視するため、環境価値と経済価値を組み合わせた立場です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Algal biomass after nutrient enrichment
stimulus.description: A hypothetical lake receives an increased nutrient input at the start of Year 1.
stimulus.note: No major management intervention occurs during the period.

question: Analyse the lake as a system by identifying the input, one likely storage or state variable, and one reinforcing feedback that could contribute to the pattern shown.
markscheme: Identifies increased nutrient input, such as nitrate or phosphate entering the lake, as an input to the system.
Identifies algal biomass, nutrients stored in biomass, or another relevant lake component as a storage/state variable.
Explains a reinforcing feedback, for example more algal biomass leads to more dead organic matter, decomposition and nutrient recycling, which can support further algal growth.
Links the reinforcing feedback to the continuing increase in the algal biomass index from about 25 to 90.
markschemeJa: 湖への硝酸塩・リン酸塩などの栄養塩増加をsystemへのinputとして示す。
藻類biomassや生物体内に保持された栄養塩などをstorage/state variableとして示す。
藻類増加→死骸増加→分解・栄養塩再循環→さらに藻類成長、などのreinforcing feedbackを説明する。
そのfeedbackをalgal biomass indexが約25から90へ継続的に増える傾向と関連づける。
modelAnswer: The added nitrate or phosphate is an input. Algal biomass is a state variable and also stores nutrients in living material. A reinforcing feedback may occur when larger algal blooms produce more dead organic matter; decomposition releases nutrients back into the water, supporting further growth. This is consistent with the index increasing from 25 to 90.
modelAnswerJa: 追加された硝酸塩やリン酸塩がinputです。藻類biomassはsystemの状態を表す変数で、生物体内に栄養塩も保持します。藻類が増えると死骸も増え、分解によって栄養塩が再び水中へ戻り、さらに成長を促すreinforcing feedbackが起こり得ます。これは指数が25から90へ増加する傾向と一致します。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Ecological footprint and biocapacity
stimulus.description: Hypothetical sustainability indicators for Country R.
stimulus.note: Assume the values remain constant for the calculation.

question: Calculate (i) the ecological deficit per person, (ii) the country's total ecological footprint, and (iii) its total biocapacity. State what the results indicate about ecological overshoot.
markscheme: Calculates ecological deficit per person as 4.8 - 2.9 = 1.9 global ha per person.
Calculates total ecological footprint as 4.8 × 20 million = 96 million global ha.
Calculates total biocapacity as 2.9 × 20 million = 58 million global ha.
Calculates or recognizes the total deficit as 96 - 58 = 38 million global ha.
States that the population is in ecological overshoot because demand exceeds domestic regenerative biocapacity.
markschemeJa: 1人当たりecological deficitを4.8−2.9＝1.9 global ha/personと計算する。
総ecological footprintを4.8×20 million＝96 million global haと計算する。
総biocapacityを2.9×20 million＝58 million global haと計算する。
総deficitを96−58＝38 million global haと計算または認識する。
需要が国内の再生能力を上回るためecological overshootの状態と述べる。
modelAnswer: The ecological deficit is 1.9 global ha per person. The total footprint is 96 million global ha and total biocapacity is 58 million global ha, giving a total deficit of 38 million global ha. Country R is therefore in ecological overshoot because its ecological demand exceeds its regenerative capacity.
modelAnswerJa: 1人当たりのecological deficitは1.9 global haです。総footprintは96 million global ha、総biocapacityは58 million global haなので、総deficitは38 million global haです。したがってCountry Rは生態系への需要が再生能力を上回るecological overshootの状態です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Herbivore population in a fenced reserve
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual estimates of a herbivore population after predators were excluded.
stimulus.note: Food availability declined after 2023.

question: Describe the population pattern and explain how carrying capacity and density-dependent factors could account for the change after 2023.
markscheme: Describes rapid population growth from about 420 in 2018 to a peak of about 1240 in 2023.
Describes the subsequent decline to about 1080 by 2025.
Explains that the population may have approached or exceeded carrying capacity as food became limiting.
Explains that density-dependent competition for food, disease or similar factors can increase at high density and reduce birth rate or increase mortality.
markschemeJa: 2018年約420から2023年約1240まで急増したと記述する。
その後2025年約1080まで減少したと記述する。
食物が制限要因となり、個体群がcarrying capacityに近づくか超えた可能性を説明する。
高密度では食物競争・病気などdensity-dependent factorが強まり、出生率低下や死亡率上昇につながると説明する。
modelAnswer: The population rises rapidly from 420 to about 1240, then falls to 1080. As density increased, the population probably approached or exceeded the reserve's carrying capacity. Declining food availability would intensify competition, and other density-dependent effects such as disease could also increase, reducing net population growth.
modelAnswerJa: 個体群は420から約1240まで急増した後、1080まで低下しています。密度上昇によってreserveのcarrying capacityに近づくか超え、食物不足による競争が強まったと考えられます。病気など他のdensity-dependent factorも強まり、個体群増加率を下げた可能性があります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Energy available at successive trophic levels
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual energy values for a grassland food chain.
stimulus.note: Use the values shown to calculate transfer efficiencies.

question: Calculate the ecological efficiency from producers to primary consumers and from primary to secondary consumers. Then explain why energy availability decreases at higher trophic levels.
markscheme: Calculates producer-to-primary-consumer efficiency as (2160 / 18000) × 100 = 12%.
Calculates primary-to-secondary-consumer efficiency as (270 / 2160) × 100 = 12.5%.
Shows a valid efficiency calculation method: energy transferred / energy available at previous trophic level × 100.
Explains that organisms use a large fraction of assimilated energy in cellular respiration and release energy as heat.
Explains that not all biomass is eaten or assimilated, with energy remaining in uneaten material, faeces or other waste.
markschemeJa: producer→primary consumerの効率を(2160÷18000)×100＝12%と計算する。
primary→secondary consumerの効率を(270÷2160)×100＝12.5%と計算する。
前のtrophic levelから移動したenergy÷利用可能energy×100という妥当な方法を示す。
取り込まれたenergyの多くがcellular respirationに使われ、heatとして散逸すると説明する。
全biomassが食べられ・同化されるわけではなく、未摂食物・糞・その他のwasteにenergyが残ると説明する。
modelAnswer: The producer-to-primary-consumer efficiency is 12%, and the primary-to-secondary efficiency is 12.5%. Energy decreases up the food chain because organisms respire and lose energy as heat, and because some biomass is not eaten or is not assimilated and is lost in waste.
modelAnswerJa: producerからprimary consumerへの効率は12%、primaryからsecondary consumerへは12.5%です。高次栄養段階ほどenergyが少なくなるのは、呼吸によってheatとして散逸すること、またbiomassの一部が食べられない・同化されずwasteになるためです。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Primary productivity in two ecosystems
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual productivity values.
stimulus.note: NPP = GPP - plant respiration.

question: Calculate the NPP of each ecosystem and compare the proportion of GPP remaining as NPP.
markscheme: Calculates tropical-forest NPP as 24000 - 14500 = 9500 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹.
Calculates grassland NPP as 14500 - 6500 = 8000 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹.
Calculates tropical-forest NPP as about 39.6% of GPP and/or grassland NPP as about 55.2% of GPP.
States that the forest has the higher absolute NPP, but the grassland retains a larger proportion of GPP as NPP.
markschemeJa: tropical forestのNPPを24000−14500＝9500 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹と計算する。
grasslandのNPPを14500−6500＝8000 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹と計算する。
forestのNPP/GPPを約39.6%、またはgrasslandを約55.2%と計算する。
absolute NPPはforestの方が高いが、GPPに対するNPP割合はgrasslandの方が高いと述べる。
modelAnswer: NPP is 9500 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹ in the tropical forest and 8000 in the grassland. These are about 39.6% and 55.2% of GPP respectively. The forest therefore has higher total NPP, but the grassland retains a larger share of captured energy after plant respiration.
modelAnswerJa: NPPはtropical forestで9500、grasslandで8000 kJ m⁻² yr⁻¹です。GPPに対してそれぞれ約39.6%、55.2%です。したがってabsolute NPPはforestの方が大きい一方、呼吸後に残る割合はgrasslandの方が大きいです。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Nitrate concentration downstream of farmland
stimulus.description: Hypothetical mean nitrate concentrations after fertilizer application.
stimulus.note: Heavy rainfall occurred during the week before sampling.

question: Explain how fertilizer use and rainfall could produce the nitrate pattern shown and identify one possible ecosystem consequence.
markscheme: Explains that nitrogen fertilizer adds ammonium and/or nitrate to agricultural soils.
Explains that nitrification can convert ammonium to nitrate and/or that nitrate is soluble and can be leached or carried by runoff after heavy rainfall.
Links transport from fields to the much higher nitrate concentration in the drainage ditch and downstream river than upstream.
Explains one consequence such as eutrophication, algal growth followed by decomposition, oxygen depletion or biodiversity change.
markschemeJa: 窒素肥料が農地土壌へammoniumやnitrateを加えると説明する。
nitrificationでammoniumがnitrateになり得ること、またnitrateは溶けやすく豪雨後にleaching/runoffで運ばれると説明する。
農地からの移動を、上流よりditch・下流河川でnitrateが高いことと関連づける。
eutrophication、algal growthとその後のdecomposition、oxygen depletion、生物多様性変化など1つの影響を説明する。
modelAnswer: Fertilizer increases inorganic nitrogen in the soil. Ammonium can be nitrified to nitrate, and nitrate is highly soluble, so heavy rainfall can move it through drainage and runoff into the river. This explains why nitrate is much higher beside and downstream of the fields. Nutrient enrichment may cause eutrophication, followed by decomposition and lower dissolved oxygen.
modelAnswerJa: 肥料によって土壌中の無機窒素が増えます。ammoniumはnitrificationでnitrateへ変化し、nitrateは水に溶けやすいため豪雨でdrainageやrunoffを通じて河川へ移動します。その結果、農地下流で濃度が高くなります。栄養塩増加はeutrophicationを引き起こし、その後の分解で溶存酸素低下につながる可能性があります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Annual carbon fluxes in a recovering forest
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual carbon fluxes for one forest area.
rows: Plant and soil respiration to atmosphere
stimulus.note: Ignore other carbon fluxes for this calculation.

question: Analyse whether the forest is acting as a net carbon sink under the stated assumptions.
markscheme: Calculates net change in ecosystem carbon as 12500 - 8700 - 900 = +2900 t C yr⁻¹.
Interprets the positive net balance as carbon accumulating in the ecosystem/forest carbon store.
Concludes that the forest is a net carbon sink under the stated assumptions, while recognizing that omitted fluxes could alter the estimate.
markschemeJa: net carbon changeを12500−8700−900＝+2900 t C/yrと計算する。
正のbalanceはecosystem/forest carbon storeに炭素が蓄積していることを意味すると解釈する。
仮定上はnet carbon sinkだが、省略されたfluxがあれば推定値は変わり得ると結論づける。
modelAnswer: The net balance is +2900 t C yr⁻¹. Because uptake exceeds respiration and harvest removal, carbon is accumulating in the forest system, so it is acting as a net sink under the stated assumptions. The conclusion is conditional because other fluxes were excluded.
modelAnswerJa: net balanceは+2900 t C/yrです。吸収量がrespirationとharvest removalの合計を上回るため、forest system内に炭素が蓄積し、仮定上はnet sinkです。ただし他のfluxを省略しているため、この結論には条件があります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Climate characteristics of two locations
stimulus.description: Hypothetical long-term mean climate data.
stimulus.note: No other environmental data are provided.

question: Describe one major climatic contrast between Locations A and B and explain how this could lead to differences in biome productivity or vegetation.
markscheme: Describes a valid contrast, such as A being much warmer and wetter than B.
Explains that warm, wet conditions generally allow longer growing seasons and higher photosynthetic productivity, supporting denser vegetation.
Explains that low temperature and/or low precipitation at B limits plant growth and is likely to support lower productivity or sparser/shorter vegetation.
markschemeJa: AはBより大幅に高温・多雨など、有効なclimatic contrastを記述する。
温暖・湿潤条件は一般に長いgrowing seasonと高いphotosynthetic productivityを可能にし、より密なvegetationを支えると説明する。
Bの低温・少雨はplant growthを制限し、低いproductivityや疎ら・低いvegetationにつながると説明する。
modelAnswer: Location A is much warmer and wetter than B. Its warm, continuously wet climate should support a longer growing season and greater photosynthesis, so productivity and vegetation biomass are likely to be higher. In B, cold temperatures and limited water restrict plant growth.
modelAnswerJa: Location AはBより大幅に高温・多雨です。年間を通じて温暖・湿潤なためgrowing seasonが長く、photosynthesisが活発になりやすく、productivityやvegetation biomassも高くなると考えられます。Bでは低温と水不足がplant growthを制限します。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Grassland management options
stimulus.description: Hypothetical outcomes after ten years.
stimulus.note: An index of 100 represents the current baseline. Other social and ecological effects are not quantified.

question: Analyse which option appears most sustainable using systems thinking and the data provided. Your answer should consider ecological and human outcomes and one limitation of the evidence.
markscheme: Recognizes that high-intensity grazing maximizes livestock output but is associated with lower native-plant index and soil-carbon loss, indicating an ecological trade-off.
Recognizes that partial exclusion gives the strongest listed ecological outcomes but reduces livestock output and has the highest listed management cost.
Analyses rotational grazing as a compromise that maintains relatively high livestock output while improving native-plant index and soil carbon.

Uses systems thinking by explaining an interaction or feedback, for example improved vegetation cover can reduce erosion and support soil carbon, which can improve soil condition and future productivity.

Recognizes a limitation, such as missing data on farmer income, biodiversity beyond plants, rainfall variability, soil erosion, animal welfare or long-term outcomes, so a final sustainability judgement remains conditional.
markschemeJa: high-intensity grazingはlivestock outputを最大化するが、native plant index低下・soil carbon減少と関連し、生態的trade-offがあると認識する。
partial exclusionは示された生態的成果が最も強いが、livestock output低下とmanagement cost最大という負担があると認識する。
rotational grazingは比較的高いlivestock outputを保ちつつnative plantとsoil carbonを改善するcompromiseとして分析する。
vegetation cover改善→erosion低下・soil carbon増加→soil conditionと将来productivity改善など、interaction/feedbackをsystems thinkingで説明する。
farmer income、生物多様性の他要素、rainfall variability、erosion、animal welfare、長期結果などが欠け、最終判断は条件付きと認識する。
modelAnswer: High-intensity grazing gives the highest livestock output, but the native-plant index falls to 62 and soil carbon declines by 14%, suggesting degradation that could weaken future system performance. Partial exclusion produces the strongest ecological recovery but reduces livestock output to 82 and costs more. Rotational grazing appears the most balanced option in the data: output remains 108 while native plants rise to 91 and soil carbon increases by 6%. Better vegetation cover and soil carbon may create beneficial feedbacks through improved soil condition and future productivity. However, the dataset omits income, erosion, rainfall variability and other biodiversity measures, so the judgement is provisional.
modelAnswerJa: high-intensity grazingはlivestock outputが最大ですが、native plant indexが62、soil carbonが14%減少し、将来のsystem performanceを弱めるdegradationが示唆されます。partial exclusionは生態回復が最も大きい一方、outputが82まで下がり費用も高いです。rotational grazingはoutput 108を維持しつつnative plant 91、soil carbon +6%で、示されたデータでは最もバランスが良いと考えられます。植生とsoil carbonの改善は土壌状態や将来productivityへのpositiveな相互作用を生み得ます。ただしincome、erosion、rainfall variability、他のbiodiversity指標がないため判断は暫定的です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Species abundance in two woodland communities
stimulus.description: Hypothetical counts from equal-sized sampling areas.
stimulus.note: Use Simpson's reciprocal index = N(N - 1) / Σn(n - 1), where N is the total number of organisms and n is the number of organisms of each species.

question: Calculate Simpson's reciprocal index for Communities A and B and compare their species diversity.
markscheme: Calculates Σn(n - 1) for Community A as 2900 and/or substitutes correctly into the stated formula.
Calculates Community A's Simpson's reciprocal index as 9900 / 2900 ≈ 3.41.
Calculates Community B's Simpson's reciprocal index as 9900 / 5100 ≈ 1.94.
Concludes that Community A has the higher species diversity because its reciprocal index is larger, reflecting greater evenness among the four species.
markschemeJa: Community AについてΣn(n−1)=2900を計算する、または示された式へ正しく代入する。
Community AのSimpson's reciprocal indexを9900÷2900≈3.41と計算する。
Community BのSimpson's reciprocal indexを9900÷5100≈1.94と計算する。
reciprocal indexが大きく4種の均等度も高いため、Community Aのspecies diversityが高いと結論づける。
modelAnswer: For Community A, N = 100 and Σn(n - 1) = 2900, so the reciprocal index is 9900 / 2900 ≈ 3.41. For Community B, Σn(n - 1) = 5100, giving 9900 / 5100 ≈ 1.94. Community A is therefore more diverse because abundance is distributed more evenly among the four species.
modelAnswerJa: 両communityともN=100です。AではΣn(n−1)=2900なので9900÷2900≈3.41、Bでは5100なので9900÷5100≈1.94です。Aの方が4種の個体数がより均等で、Simpson's reciprocal indexも大きいためspecies diversityが高いと判断できます。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Forest fragmentation and a specialist bird
stimulus.description: Hypothetical observations from three landscapes with similar total forest area.
stimulus.note: The bird index is relative; 100 represents the reference landscape.

question: Analyse how habitat fragmentation could account for the pattern in the forest-specialist bird index.
markscheme: Identifies that fragmentation increases from one patch in A to 14 patches in C and that mean isolation also increases.
Identifies the associated decline in the bird index from 100 to 72 to 48.
Explains that smaller or more isolated patches can reduce movement, access to mates/resources or recolonization, increasing local population risk.
Explains that a greater proportion of habitat may be influenced by edge effects, altering microclimate, predation or habitat quality for forest specialists.
markschemeJa: Aの1 patchからCの14 patchesへfragmentationが増え、patch間距離も増加すると示す。
それに伴いbird indexが100→72→48へ低下すると示す。
小さく孤立したpatchでは移動、mate/resourceへのアクセス、recolonizationが難しくなり、local population riskが高まると説明する。
edge effectを受ける割合が増え、microclimate・predation・habitat qualityがforest specialistに不利になると説明する。
modelAnswer: The most fragmented landscape has both more patches and greater isolation, while the specialist-bird index falls from 100 to 48. Fragmentation can restrict movement and gene flow, make recolonization harder and reduce access to suitable breeding habitat. Smaller patches also contain proportionally more edge habitat, where altered temperature, wind or predation can lower habitat quality for forest specialists.
modelAnswerJa: fragmentationが強いほどpatch数と孤立度が増え、forest-specialist bird indexは100から48まで低下しています。patch間移動やgene flow、再定着が難しくなり、繁殖に適したhabitatへのアクセスも低下します。また小さなpatchほどedge habitatの割合が大きくなり、温度・風・捕食などのedge effectがforest specialistに不利に働きます。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Conservation options for an endangered forest mammal
stimulus.description: Hypothetical management information.
rows: Protects breeding habitat and natural interactions
Requires land outside the current reserve
Can increase numbers under controlled conditions
Does not by itself remove habitat threats in the wild
stimulus.note: The remaining wild population occurs in two isolated forest patches.

question: Compare the three options and suggest a combined conservation strategy for the species.
markscheme: Explains that protected habitat is in situ conservation that maintains the species within its natural ecosystem but does not solve isolation by itself.
Explains that a wildlife corridor can restore connectivity, movement and gene flow between isolated subpopulations.
Explains that captive breeding is ex situ conservation that may increase numbers or preserve genetic material but does not remove the original habitat threat.

Suggests a justified combination, such as protecting both habitat patches and creating a corridor, with captive breeding used only if the wild population is too small for recovery without additional support.
markschemeJa: protected habitatはnatural ecosystem内で守るin situ conservationだが、単独ではisolationを解決しないと説明する。
wildlife corridorは孤立個体群間のconnectivity、移動、gene flowを回復できると説明する。
captive breedingは個体数やgenetic materialを確保できるex situ conservationだが、野外のhabitat threatそのものは除去しないと説明する。
両habitat patchの保護＋corridorを基本とし、野生個体群が小さすぎる場合にcaptive breedingを補助的に使うなど、根拠ある組合せを提案する。
modelAnswer: Protected habitat should be the foundation because it conserves the animal in its natural ecosystem. A corridor is also important because the two subpopulations are isolated and need movement and gene flow. Captive breeding may be useful as a backup if numbers are dangerously low, but releasing animals will not succeed if habitat threats remain. The strongest strategy therefore combines habitat protection and connectivity, with ex situ support only where necessary.
modelAnswerJa: 基本はnatural habitatを守るprotected areaです。さらに2つの個体群が孤立しているためcorridorでmovementとgene flowを回復する必要があります。captive breedingは個体数が危険なほど少ない場合の補助手段になりますが、habitat threatが残れば放獣しても持続しません。したがってhabitat protection＋connectivityを中心に、必要な場合だけex situ supportを組み合わせるのが妥当です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Annual water budget for a drainage basin
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual values for a 200 km² drainage basin.
stimulus.note: Assume runoff = precipitation - evapotranspiration - change in storage. 1 mm over 1 km² = 1,000 m³.

question: Calculate (i) annual runoff depth and (ii) the corresponding annual runoff volume from the basin. Show your working.
markscheme: Uses the stated water-budget relationship with the correct components.
Calculates runoff depth as 920 - 510 - 40 = 370 mm.
Converts 370 mm over 200 km² to 370 × 200 × 1000 m³.
Calculates annual runoff volume as 74,000,000 m³, or 74 million m³.
markschemeJa: 示されたwater-budget式に正しいcomponentを代入する。
runoff depthを920−510−40＝370 mmと計算する。
370 mm×200 km²×1000 m³へ正しく換算する。
annual runoff volumeを74,000,000 m³、すなわち74 million m³と計算する。
modelAnswer: Runoff depth = 920 - 510 - 40 = 370 mm. Because 1 mm over 1 km² equals 1,000 m³, the runoff volume is 370 × 200 × 1,000 = 74,000,000 m³ per year.
modelAnswerJa: runoff depthは920−510−40＝370 mmです。1 mmが1 km²に対応すると1,000 m³なので、370×200×1,000＝74,000,000 m³/年、つまり74 million m³/年です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Freshwater use in Region M
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual water-resource data.
stimulus.note: Use the values shown; do not assume that all withdrawn water is consumed.

question: Calculate (i) total withdrawals as a percentage of renewable freshwater availability, (ii) renewable freshwater availability per person, and (iii) agriculture's share of total withdrawals. Interpret what the results suggest about water stress.
markscheme: Calculates withdrawals as 720 / 900 × 100 = 80% of renewable freshwater availability.
Calculates renewable freshwater availability per person as 900 million m³ / 1.5 million people = 600 m³ person⁻¹ yr⁻¹.
Calculates agriculture's share of withdrawals as 520 / 720 × 100 ≈ 72.2%.
Recognizes that withdrawing an amount equal to 80% of renewable availability indicates strong pressure on the regional water system, especially during dry periods or variable supply.

Recognizes that agriculture is the dominant withdrawal sector in the data and is therefore an important target for efficiency or demand-management measures, while noting that withdrawal is not identical to consumption.
markschemeJa: withdrawal割合を720÷900×100＝80%と計算する。
1人当たりrenewable freshwater availabilityを900 million m³÷1.5 million＝600 m³/person/yrと計算する。
agricultureのwithdrawal shareを520÷720×100≈72.2%と計算する。
renewable availabilityの80%に相当する取水は、特に乾季や供給変動時にwater systemへ強いpressureを示すと解釈する。
agricultureが主要withdrawal sectorであり効率化・需要管理の重要対象と認識しつつ、withdrawalとconsumptionは同じではないとする。
modelAnswer: Total withdrawals equal 80% of renewable freshwater availability. Availability is 600 m³ per person per year, and agriculture accounts for about 72.2% of withdrawals. These figures show strong pressure on the regional water supply, with agriculture the largest withdrawal sector. However, withdrawals should not be treated as identical to consumption because some water may return to the system.
modelAnswerJa: total withdrawalはrenewable freshwater availabilityの80%です。1人当たりavailabilityは600 m³/年、agricultureはwithdrawalの約72.2%を占めます。したがって地域の水資源には強いpressureがあり、特にagricultureの効率化が重要です。ただしwithdrawalのすべてが消費されるわけではないため、withdrawalとconsumptionを同一視してはいけません。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Catch and fishing effort for a coastal fish stock
stimulus.description: Hypothetical fishery records. Fishing effort is an index, with 2015 = 100.
stimulus.note: Use catch per unit effort (CPUE) = catch / fishing-effort index as a simple relative indicator; it is not a direct stock-size measurement.

question: Calculate CPUE for 2015 and 2025, calculate the percentage decline in CPUE, and analyse what the pattern may indicate about the fish stock.
markscheme: Calculates 2015 CPUE as 50 / 100 = 0.50 catch units per effort-index unit.
Calculates 2025 CPUE as 38 / 150 ≈ 0.253.
Calculates the decline in CPUE as approximately (0.50 - 0.253) / 0.50 × 100 ≈ 49.3%.

Analyses that rising effort combined with falling catch and an approximately 49% CPUE decline is consistent with declining stock abundance or overfishing pressure, while recognizing that CPUE is only a proxy.
markschemeJa: effort増加にもかかわらずcatchとCPUEが低下することはstock abundance低下やoverfishing pressureと整合するが、CPUEはproxyにすぎないと分析する。
modelAnswer: CPUE falls from 0.50 in 2015 to about 0.253 in 2025, a decline of about 49.3%. Fishing effort rises by 50% while catch falls from 50 to 38 thousand tonnes. This pattern is consistent with a declining stock and possible overfishing, although CPUE can also be affected by gear, location and fishing behaviour.
modelAnswerJa: CPUEは2015年0.50から2025年約0.253へ低下し、約49.3%の減少です。fishing effortは50%増えたのにcatchは50から38 thousand tへ減っています。このpatternはstock declineやoverfishingと整合しますが、CPUEはgear・location・fishing behaviourにも影響されるproxyです。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Two aquaculture systems
stimulus.description: Hypothetical annual production data.
rows: Nitrogen released to receiving water (t yr⁻¹)
stimulus.note: Feed conversion ratio (FCR) = feed supplied / fish produced. A lower FCR indicates less feed used per unit fish produced.

question: Calculate the FCR of each system and compare their environmental trade-offs using the data provided.
markscheme: Calculates open-cage FCR as 2400 / 1600 = 1.50.
Calculates recirculating-system FCR as 2100 / 1750 = 1.20.
Explains that the recirculating system uses feed more efficiently and releases much less nitrogen to receiving water in the stated data.
Recognizes the trade-off that the recirculating system has a much higher electricity-use index, so lower local nutrient pollution does not necessarily mean lower total environmental impact.
markschemeJa: open cageのFCRを2400÷1600＝1.50と計算する。
recirculating systemのFCRを2100÷1750＝1.20と計算する。
recirculating systemはfeed efficiencyが高く、受水域へのnitrogen releaseも大幅に少ないと説明する。
一方でelectricity-use indexが高いため、local nutrient pollution低下がtotal environmental impact低下を必ずしも意味しないtrade-offを認識する。
modelAnswer: The open-cage FCR is 1.50 and the recirculating-system FCR is 1.20, so the recirculating system uses less feed per tonne of fish. It also releases only 14 t of nitrogen compared with 64 t from open cages. However, its electricity-use index is 1.8 rather than 1.0, so energy source and associated emissions would matter in a full sustainability comparison.
modelAnswerJa: open cageのFCRは1.50、recirculating systemは1.20なので、後者の方がfeed efficiencyが高いです。nitrogen releaseも64 tに対して14 tと小さいです。一方electricity-use indexは1.8と高いため、完全なsustainability比較ではenergy sourceやemissionsも考慮する必要があります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: River water-quality survey
stimulus.description: Hypothetical mean measurements from four sites.
stimulus.note: The survey shows spatial associations but does not by itself prove the source of every pollutant.

question: Analyse the water-quality pattern and infer the likely influence of sewage and agricultural runoff.
markscheme: Uses the sharp BOD increase and dissolved-oxygen decrease below the sewage outfall as evidence consistent with organic pollution and microbial decomposition.
Uses the large nitrate increase below agricultural drainage as evidence consistent with nutrient runoff from farmland.
Recognizes that further downstream nitrate remains elevated and dissolved oxygen remains lower than the upstream reference, indicating combined or persistent downstream effects.
Recognizes a limitation: the spatial pattern supports inference but does not by itself prove causation or exclude other pollution sources.
markschemeJa: sewage outfall直下でBODが大きく上がりDOが下がることを、organic pollutionとmicrobial decompositionに整合する証拠として使う。
agricultural drainage直下でnitrateが大きく増えることを、farmlandからのnutrient runoffと整合する証拠として使う。
さらに下流でもnitrateが高くDOが上流より低いため、複合的または持続的なdownstream effectを認識する。
spatial patternは推論を支えるが、因果関係を証明せず他sourceも排除できないという限界を認識する。
modelAnswer: Below the sewage outfall, BOD rises from 1.4 to 7.8 mg L⁻¹ while dissolved oxygen falls from 9.2 to 5.1 mg L⁻¹, which is consistent with organic matter being decomposed by microbes. Below agricultural drainage, nitrate rises sharply to 5.4 mg L⁻¹, consistent with fertilizer runoff. Further downstream, water quality has not returned to reference conditions, suggesting combined pressures. The pattern is suggestive rather than proof of source attribution.
modelAnswerJa: sewage outfall直下ではBODが1.4から7.8 mg/Lへ上昇し、DOが9.2から5.1へ低下しており、微生物によるorganic matter分解と整合します。agricultural drainage直下ではnitrateが5.4 mg/Lへ急増し、fertilizer runoffと整合します。さらに下流でもreference levelへ戻っておらず、複合pressureが示唆されます。ただしこのspatial patternだけでsourceを断定はできません。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Pollution sources entering Lake P
stimulus.description: Hypothetical catchment information.
rows: Effluent enters the lake through one identified pipe.
Fertilizer is applied across 8,000 ha; runoff reaches many small streams after rain.
Seasonal algal blooms have become more frequent.
stimulus.note: Both sources may contribute nutrients.

question: Distinguish the two pollution-source types and explain how nutrient inputs can cause eutrophication and oxygen depletion.
markscheme: Identifies the wastewater pipe as point-source pollution and agricultural runoff as non-point-source pollution.
Explains that added nitrate/phosphate can increase algal or phytoplankton growth, producing eutrophication/algal blooms.
Explains that when excess biomass dies, decomposition increases oxygen demand and can lower dissolved oxygen, harming aquatic organisms.
markschemeJa: wastewater pipeをpoint-source pollution、agricultural runoffをnon-point-source pollutionと識別する。
nitrate/phosphate増加がalgae/phytoplankton growthを促進し、eutrophication/algal bloomを引き起こすと説明する。
過剰biomassが死ぬとdecompositionによるoxygen demandが増え、DO低下とaquatic organismへの害につながると説明する。
modelAnswer: The treatment outlet is a point source because pollutants enter from one identifiable pipe. Fertilizer runoff is non-point because it is diffuse across many fields and streams. Added nitrogen and phosphorus can stimulate algal growth. When this biomass dies, decomposers respire while breaking it down, increasing oxygen demand and potentially creating low-oxygen conditions.
modelAnswerJa: treatment outletは1本の特定可能なpipeから入るためpoint sourceです。fertilizer runoffは多くのfieldやstreamから拡散的に入るためnon-point sourceです。NやPが増えるとalgal growthが進み、死んだbiomassの分解で微生物のrespirationが増えてoxygen demandが高まり、低酸素状態を引き起こし得ます。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Floodplain management options
stimulus.description: Hypothetical outcomes projected ten years after implementation.
stimulus.note: A value of 100 represents the present baseline. Lower peak flood-flow index indicates lower flood peaks.

question: Analyse which option appears to provide the most balanced management of biodiversity, water regulation and human use. Include one limitation of the evidence.
markscheme: Recognizes that more drainage increases agricultural output but is associated with habitat loss and higher peak flood flow, creating ecological and flood-risk trade-offs.
Recognizes that wetland restoration produces the strongest habitat and flood-regulation outcomes but substantially reduces agricultural output and has the highest listed cost.
Analyses mixed zoning and wetland buffers as a compromise, with agricultural output close to baseline while habitat improves and peak flood flow falls.

Recognizes a limitation such as missing data on farmer income, water quality, groundwater recharge, species composition, extreme floods or long-term maintenance, so the sustainability judgement is conditional.
markschemeJa: more drainageはagricultural outputを増やすが、habitat低下とpeak flood flow増加を伴い、生態・洪水riskのtrade-offがあると認識する。
wetland restorationはhabitatとflood regulationで最良だが、agricultural outputを大きく下げ、costも最大と認識する。
mixed zoning＋wetland bufferはagricultural outputをbaseline近くに保ちつつhabitatを改善しpeak flood flowを下げるcompromiseと分析する。
farmer income、water quality、groundwater recharge、species composition、extreme flood、長期maintenanceなど不足データを示し、判断は条件付きとする。
modelAnswer: More drainage maximizes agricultural output but reduces wetland habitat and raises the peak-flow index, so it may increase flood risk. Full restoration gives the strongest biodiversity and flood-regulation outcomes, but agricultural output falls to 78 and cost is highest. Mixed zoning appears most balanced in the stated data: agricultural output remains near baseline at 101, habitat rises to 108 and peak flow falls to 84. The judgement is provisional because water quality, income, extreme-event performance and long-term maintenance are not included.
modelAnswerJa: more drainageはagricultural outputを最大化しますが、wetland habitatを低下させpeak-flow indexを118へ上げるためflood riskを高める可能性があります。full restorationはbiodiversityとflood regulationで最も強い一方、outputが78まで低下しcostも最大です。mixed zoningはoutput 101を維持しつつhabitat 108、peak flow 84で、示されたdataでは最もバランスが良いです。ただしwater quality、income、extreme event、長期maintenanceが含まれず、判断は暫定的です。
